sql: SELECT * FROM ((SELECT 1 AS g, p.market_ticker AS a, coalesce(p.series_ticker,'-') AS b, p.end_date::text AS c, coalesce(p.period_reward_usd::text,'-') AS d, coalesce(p.target_size::text,'-') AS e, p.paid_out::text AS f, p.last_seen_at::text AS h FROM incentive_programs p WHERE p.paid_out IS TRUE ORDER BY p.end_date DESC LIMIT 25) UNION ALL (SELECT 2 AS g, p2.market_ticker, coalesce(p2.series_ticker,'-'), p2.end_date::text, coalesce(p2.period_reward_usd::text,'-'), coalesce(p2.target_size::text,'-'), coalesce(p2.paid_out::text,'null'), p2.last_seen_at::text FROM incentive_programs p2 WHERE p2.market_ticker IN ('KXUSLEI-26SEP18-T0.2','KXTRUMPAPPROVE-26SEP18-E39.4','KXBIGGESTQUAKE-17SEP26-6.8','KXBIGGESTQUAKE-17SEP26-7.0','KXAAAGASDAZ-26SEP18-4.6800','KXYTVIEWSHIGH-POS26OCT-8.75M') ORDER BY p2.last_seen_at DESC LIMIT 12)) u ORDER BY g, c DESC
